---
name: intel-bridge
description: Converts external analyst intelligence into structured, non-authoritative evidence in Demon.
---

Accept ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, human, scouting, and uploaded research as evidence. Require source, author, created/effective times, Runner event ID, entities, observation type, claim, evidence, confidence, verification, expiration, and tags. Never overwrite model truth. Only verified or explicitly approved evidence may influence high-confidence production outputs.
